purpose: Exact identity manifest for the 1353 versioned runtime, test and provenance resources: the original 1279 plus byte-exact Pulsars.dat, PLEIADES.HTL, CLEA_GLX.DAT and Hubble.HTL included under the explicit second resource approval of 2026-10-26, plus six prepared Pegasus resources (bounded NGC 7501 GSC field subset, provenance, targets, V references and independent vectors) under the user approval of 2026-10-27, plus the nine byte-exact LSS_Field01..09.HTL survey lists included under the second resource approval of 2026-10-26. Original, derived and authored resources are distinguished in RESOURCE-PROVENANCE.json; all earlier resource bytes and entries remain unchanged, plus the 11 bounded LSS field packs, witnesses and provenance in data/lss under the user approval of 2026-10-27 (N2230/N3000 read witnesses for the LSS strip only), plus byte-exact LSSFields.LST, GLIMAGES.LST and GLXYSP.LST under the user approval of 2026-10-27 (groups 1 and 2), plus byte-exact ObjectX.HTL (second approval of 2026-10-26) and the Object X orbit files ObjX_MPC.CMO and ObjX_AST.CMO (user approval of 2026-10-27), plus byte-exact ObjX_MPC.CMO.sav (user approval recorded in AGENTS.md, e296ae4), plus Front F derived Hubble resources (frozen existing-target fingerprints; UM-I – 3 cached-pan provenance, target, workbook V reference and independent Python pan vectors), derived from already-approved resources only, plus byte-exact CLEA_QSO.DAT (second user approval of 2026-10-26; SHA-256 69ecc5bf…90b5) for the recovered QSO merge, and its independent Python merge witnesses, plus Front F derived Coma engine pack (reads byte-equal to the published LSS field 3/4 reads) and the recorded engine-target metadata, plus the derived Boötes engine pack (with the approved whole N3000 records 512620/512802) and its independent witness, plus Front F Object X spectroscopy: seven bounded GSC packs for the ObjectX.HTL spectroscopy targets (user approval of 2026-10-27, group 2), their provenance and independent witnesses, and byte-exact QSOSpect.dat (approval of 2026-10-27, group 1), plus byte-exact JSPEC2.SPI (approval of 2026-10-27, group 1) for the Object X star branch, plus the four byte-exact Object X galaxy photographs NGC2403/4262/4631/4656.BMP (user approval of 2026-10-28), plus the byte-exact jspect2 template A0000046.SP required by the Object X row-12 star N3000.DAT@483032 (user approval of 2026-10-27, group 1), plus data/objectx/frozen-observations.json (a derived regression record of the Object X spectrometer: digests and integers only), plus the Front V variable-star resources (see RESOURCE-PROVENANCE.json), plus the Pleiades variable-field photometer targets (rows 3, 5, 10; derived fields and independent vectors, coordinator decision of 2026-10-28), plus the Pleiades pointing-association photometer targets (rows 2, 7, 12, 14, 22; recovered native selection, coordinator decision of 2026-10-28). Plus byte-exact NkdEye.dat (user approval of 2026-10-28, Front O Naked Eye Star) and the derived Front O witness data/fieldinfo/info-witness.json (from already-approved resources), plus the Front T independent LSS true-dispatch row witness (data/variables/lss-true-dispatch-witness.json, derived).
